{{Top|leg}}
The '''Accolux Township''' was a prestigious residential area in the nation of [[Yedagon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

As part of the misinformation campaign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Adumari Union]], it was falsely reported that it lost six residential blocks during a bombing raid the [[Lords of Dismay Flightknife]]&mdash;forces still loyal to the deposed [[Pekaelic ke Teldan|perator]] of [[Cartann]].<ref name="soa" />
